tickets.title: Prepare life insurance coverage analysis
tickets.text: Prepare life insurance coverage analysis for Alina and Derek Mossbutton reflecting Nora’s adoption, Derek’s reduced household income during unpaid leave, the $412,000 mortgage balance, and current group and term policies. Alina has employer group life insurance equal to one times salary; Derek has a $250,000 term policy with Moonbadger Life through 2041.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to prepare life insurance coverage analysis by 2026-03-09 reflecting Nora’s adoption, Derek’s reduced household income during leave, the mortgage balance, and current group and term policies.

tickets.title: Create childcare and education funding tradeoff view
tickets.text: Create one view of childcare and education funding tradeoffs for the Mossbutton household. Compare the $2,150 per month preferred daycare quote and desired college savings contributions against the same monthly surplus, showing reserve impact, dependent-care reimbursements, and possible education account funding levels.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2026-03-12 to create one view of childcare and education funding tradeoffs because the daycare quote and desired college savings contribution would draw from the same monthly surplus, showing reserve impact, dependent-care reimbursements, and possible education account funding levels.

tickets.title: Address dependent-care enrollment timing
tickets.text: Address dependent-care enrollment timing for Derek Mossbutton, whose employer portal shows a benefits enrollment window closing soon. Clarify which parent’s dependent-care arrangement should be used given the expected daycare start and Derek’s unpaid leave transition.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2026-02-27 to address dependent-care enrollment timing because Derek’s employer portal shows a benefits enrollment window closing soon, and Alina was unsure which parent’s dependent-care arrangement should be used given the expected daycare start and leave transition.
